Subtract 164 days from 1483-10-08.  
1483 is a common year.  
Days in October after 8th: 31 - 8 = 23 days remaining.  
164 - 23 = 141 days left to go back into earlier months.  
September (30 days) → 141 - 30 = 111 left.  
August (31) → 111 - 31 = 80 left.  
July (31) → 80 - 31 = 49 left.  
June (30) → 49 - 30 = 19 left.  
May (31) → 19 - 31 = -12, so we stop in May.  
May has 31 days, so 31 - 12 = 19th of May.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1483-05-19
